novel_features.name: Lineup auditor and ergonomic XML slot setter
novel_features.description: Audit active starting slots for OUT, IR, or BYE players, preview bench swaps, and submit Yahoo XML roster updates.
novel_features.rationale: Combines roster + league position rules validation with automatic synthesis of Yahoo's <fantasy_content><roster> XML payload.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use this instead of raw PUT /roster calls when checking for inactive starters or moving players between starting, bench, and IR slots.

novel_features.name: Atomic add/drop and FAAB waiver claim builder
novel_features.description: Execute or dry-run free-agent adds, drops, atomic add/drops, and FAAB waiver claims with automatic XML payload construction.
novel_features.rationale: Validates player availability and team FAAB balance before generating Yahoo's mandatory <fantasy_content><transaction> XML envelope.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use this to safely preview and submit single adds, drops, or atomic add/drop waiver claims without hand-writing Yahoo XML.

novel_features.name: Positional waiver and free-agent upgrade recommender
novel_features.description: Rank available free agents and waiver players by net points-per-game upgrade over your weakest bench player at each position.
novel_features.rationale: Joins your team roster against league free agents, player stats, and ownership percentages locally or live.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this before Tuesday waiver runs to find highest-leverage roster upgrades without scanning raw 25-player pages.

novel_features.name: Head-to-head matchup radar and slot advantage breakdown
novel_features.description: Compare both opponents' starting lineups slot-by-slot with projected vs. actual points, remaining starters, and injury flags.
novel_features.rationale: Merges league scoreboard totals with both teams' weekly rosters to expose positional mismatches.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use this for a complete single-call head-to-head matchup breakdown instead of fetching scoreboard and two team rosters separately.

novel_features.name: All-play standings, power rankings, and schedule luck
novel_features.description: Compute every team's true weekly all-play record, schedule luck delta, scoring consistency, and composite power rank.
novel_features.rationale: Aggregates multi-week scoreboards and standings in local SQLite to separate true team strength from matchup schedule luck.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use this when evaluating true league contenders and unlucky teams beyond raw win-loss standings.

novel_features.name: League FAAB burn and waiver bid intelligence
novel_features.description: Track every manager's remaining FAAB budget, positional spending breakdown, winning bids, and blocking bid thresholds.
novel_features.rationale: Joins league team FAAB balances with historical transaction bid amounts in local SQLite.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use this before setting a FAAB bid to see exactly how much budget rival managers have left and what they typically bid.

novel_features.name: Draft capital ROI and steals/busts analyzer
novel_features.description: Evaluate snake draft rounds or auction dollar costs against season-to-date fantasy points and current roster retention.
novel_features.rationale: Joins draft_results, player season stats, and rosters in local SQLite without hitting Yahoo API rate limits.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use this to grade draft performance and identify the highest-surplus steals and biggest busts in the league.

narrative.headline: Full Yahoo Fantasy Sports read/write CLI and MCP server — set lineups, execute add/drops and FAAB waiver claims, and run local SQLite league analytics.
narrative.value_prop: Wraps the complete Yahoo Fantasy Sports v2 API for NFL, NBA, MLB, and NHL with automatic XML payload construction for lineup changes (`lineup`) and free-agent/waiver transactions (`add-drop`). Syncs leagues, rosters, matchups, draft results, and transactions into a local SQLite store for instant FTS5 search, all-play power rankings (`power-rankings`), waiver upgrade recommendations (`waiver-wire`), and FAAB bid audits (`faab-audit`).
narrative.auth_narrative: Set `YAHOO_ACCESS_TOKEN` (or `YAHOO_FANTASY_TOKEN`) with a Yahoo OAuth 2.0 Bearer token, or configure `YAHOO_CLIENT_ID`, `YAHOO_CLIENT_SECRET`, and `YAHOO_REFRESH_TOKEN` so the CLI can automatically refresh expired access tokens against `https://api.login.yahoo.com/oauth2/get_token`.

quickstart.comment: List your Yahoo Fantasy NFL leagues and league keys
Inspect your team's week 9 starting lineup and bench
Preview a starting lineup slot swap before sending the XML PUT request
Preview an atomic add/drop waiver claim with a $15 FAAB bid

troubleshoots.fix: Refresh your Yahoo OAuth2 Bearer token or set YAHOO_CLIENT_ID, YAHOO_CLIENT_SECRET, and YAHOO_REFRESH_TOKEN for automatic token refresh.

troubleshoots.symptom: 400 Bad Request when changing lineup or adding/dropping a player
troubleshoots.fix: Run `lineup --dry-run` or `add-drop --dry-run` first to verify player keys (`{game_id}.p.{player_id}`) and positional eligibility (`QB`, `RB`, `WR`, `TE`, `W/R/T`, `BN`, `IR`).

troubleshoots.symptom: Rate limit (HTTP 429 / 999) during multi-week scoreboard or player queries
troubleshoots.fix: Run `yahoo-fantasy-pp-cli sync --full` to cache league data in local SQLite, then pass `--data-source local` to analytical commands.

narrative.when_to_use: Use this CLI and MCP server to inspect Yahoo Fantasy Football (and NBA/MLB/NHL) leagues, standings, weekly matchups, rosters, and free agents, as well as to execute starting lineup changes (`lineup`), free-agent pickups, drops, and FAAB waiver claims (`add-drop`). Prefer the compound commands (`lineup`, `add-drop`, `waiver-wire`, `matchup-radar`, `power-rankings`, `faab-audit`, `draft-roi`) over raw endpoint calls.
anti_triggers: Do not use this CLI for Yahoo Finance stock quotes or options chains (use yahoo-finance-pp-cli).
Do not use this CLI for ESPN or Sleeper fantasy leagues.
Do not execute live roster or transaction mutations without previewing via --dry-run when user intent is ambiguous.
